items.title: Ebola risk raised to 'very high' in DR Congo
items.description: The head of the UN health agency says the risk in the wider region is "high", but it remains "low" at the global level.

items.title: Rubio tries to reassure Nato allies over US troop deployments
items.description: President Donald Trump says he wants to send more troops to Poland, a week after his officials cancelled a similar deployment.

items.title: Cubans grapple with fuel shortages and blackouts as US steps up pressure
items.description: The BBC speaks to Havana residents after the US charges the country's former leader, Raúl Castro, with murder.

items.title: UK scientists developing Ebola vaccine that could be ready for trials in months
items.description: The rare species of Ebola involved - known as Bundibugyo - kills around a third of those infected and has no proven vaccine yet.

items.title: US navy chief says $14bn arms sale to Taiwan paused due to Iran war
items.description: Hung Cao told a Senate hearing they were "doing a pause" on the sale to make sure they had munitions for the Iran war.

items.title: Turkish opposition fights court ousting of leaders in ruling boosting Erdoğan
items.description: The appeal court declared Özgür Özel's party leadership victory void, further cementing the president's grip on power.

items.title: AI used to fake evidence that ended Korean actor's career, say police
items.description: Police are seeking an arrest warrant for a YouTuber who allegedly fabricated evidence to defame actor Kim Soo-hyun.

items.title: Alberta to hold referendum on whether to remain in Canada
items.description: Voters in the western province will decide next October whether they want to stay in Canada or move ahead with a process for a binding independence referendum.

items.title: Rubio says Cuba is threat to US as Havana accuses him of 'lies'
items.description: Cuba's foreign minister accused Rubio of trying to "instigate a military aggression".

items.title: Africa summit in India postponed over Ebola outbreak fears
items.description: The India-Africa summit was set to be held next week in Delhi after more than a decade.

items.title: Slow Food founder Carlo Petrini dies aged 76
items.description: Petrini's movement rejected fast food to promote sustainable production and traditional cooking.

items.title: 'No means no': Greenlanders protest against Trump outside new US consulate
items.description: The inauguration of the new consulate comes amid a push by the US president for greater control over the island.
